request.style: English, solemn female soprano solo with low string quartet, harp, organ, and timpani, dark and foreboding mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Hear this word, you cows of Bashan
Living on Mount Samaria
You oppress the poor and crush the needy
Saying, Bring us something to drink

[Verse]
The Lord GOD has sworn by his holiness
Days are coming upon you
You will be carried off with hooks
The last of you with fishhooks

[Verse]
You will go out through breaches in the wall
Each woman straight ahead of her
You will be cast out toward Harmon
Declares the LORD, the end is near
